name: Integration - LLM Provider Selection and Initialization
description: Verifies that the agent initializes the correct LLM client based on the LLM_PROVIDER environment variable and raises an error for unsupported providers.
input: Environment variable LLM_PROVIDER set to 'openai', 'anthropic', and an unsupported value.
output: Correct client is initialized for supported providers; ValueError is raised for unsupported provider.
success_criteria: AsyncOpenAI client is initialized when LLM_PROVIDER is 'openai'
ValueError is raised for unsupported provider
error_scenarios: No error is raised for unsupported provider
